view: Silver and gold have rebounded for two days from near one-year lows on value buying (Silver BeES +4.2% and Gold BeES +2.8% on 27 November), but stronger-than-expected US inflation has kept a December US rate rise priced in, which has been the main pressure on bullion.
watch: The 8–9 December Fed decision and the dollar.

watch: RBI decision on 4 December and foreign investor flows.

view: Indian IT services stocks led the 27 November fall (HCL Tech, Infosys and TCS down about 2.5–2.8%) on proposed US tariffs on trading partners including India; Geojit also flagged that a revival in Asian AI stocks could divert flows away from India.
watch: US tariff decisions and December-quarter results from January.

view: Record copper prices drove Hindustan Copper's profit surge, but copper has since slipped to a five-month low on a strong dollar and weak China data, dragging metal stocks.
watch: Global copper prices and the dollar.

view: The RBI is in a tightening phase, which tends to lower bond prices in the short term and raise yields on new bonds.
